name: ShadowGraph Market Intelligence
description: Global evidence-ranked relationship, validated price-lag, market-signal and procurement-opportunity intelligence for autonomous agents. Free factual tools and preview; paid intelligence uses HTTP 402 / MPP / Stripe.

skills.name: Global market recap
skills.description: Free compact answer to what moved in global markets today, with current movers and recent thematic news.
examples: What moved in global markets today?

skills.name: Latest official company filings
skills.description: Free recent SEC EDGAR filing lookup for supported ticker symbols.
examples: Show me the latest NVDA SEC filings.

skills.name: EU procurement search
skills.description: Free search over current EU TED procurement notices by keyword or buyer country.
examples: Find open EU data-center tenders in Germany.

skills.name: Free global intelligence preview
skills.description: Inspect live global coverage, graph size and top measured price-lag relationship before purchasing.
examples: Show me a free preview of your current global intelligence coverage.

skills.name: Global hidden-relationship snapshot
skills.description: Paid $0.50 call for global hidden relationships across official filings, procurement, markets and infrastructure.
examples: Give me the current global hidden relationship snapshot.

skills.name: Global market signal
skills.description: Paid $0.75 call for directional market intelligence with measured lead-lag evidence and invalidation logic.
examples: What is the strongest global market signal right now?

skills.name: Global procurement and commercial opportunity
skills.description: Paid $1.00 call for evidence-backed supplier, procurement and second-order commercial opportunities.
examples: Find the strongest global procurement or supplier opportunity.

skills.name: Global intelligence brief
skills.description: Paid $2.50 call for a higher-density brief combining official filings, procurement, global news, relationship graph, measured lags and commercial opportunities.
examples: Give me the current global intelligence brief.

skills.name: Deep research pack
skills.description: Paid $5.00 call for an expanded machine-readable research pack with official evidence, graph relationships, price lags and commercial opportunity analysis.
examples: Run a deep research pack on the current global environment.
